changed.title: Typical largest extension dimension of a mixed space on the singular spacing-two cycle
changed.statement:
∀ D : ℕ → ℕ, (∀ t, 2 ≤ D t) →
  Filter.Tendsto (fun t : ℕ => ((D t : ℝ)+1)*Real.sqrt ((2 : ℝ)^(D t))/(t : ℝ))
    Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
  ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε →
  Filter.Tendsto (fun t : ℕ =>
  letI : ∀ p : Prop, Decidable p := Classical.propDecidable
  let F := ZMod 2
  let n := 6*t
  let a := 3*t
  let W := Fin n → F
  letI : Fintype (Submodule F W) := Fintype.ofFinite _
  let next := fun i : Fin n =>
    (⟨(i.val+1) % n, Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le _) i.isLt)⟩ : Fin n)
  let h := fun (i : Fin n) (b : Fin 4) =>
    if i.val % 2 = b.val / 2 ∧ (i.val / 2 % 3 = b.val % 2 ∨ i.val / 2 % 3 = 2)
    then (1:F) else 0
  let good := fun U : Submodule F W =>
    (∀ x ∈ U, ∀ b : Fin 4, (∑ i, h i b * x i) = 0) ∧
    (∀ x ∈ U, ∀ y ∈ U, ∀ i, x i * y (next i) = x (next i) * y i)
  let supp := fun U : Submodule F W =>
    Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin n => ∃ x ∈ U, x i ≠ 0)
  let sites := fun (S : Finset (Fin n)) (p : ℕ) =>
    (S.filter (fun i => i.val % 2 = p)).card
  let spaces := (Finset.univ : Finset (Submodule F W)).filter good
  let mixed := spaces.filter (fun U => 0 < sites (supp U) 0 ∧ 0 < sites (supp U) 1)
  let d := D t
  let layer := mixed.filter (fun U : Submodule F W => Module.finrank F U = d)
  let host := fun U : Submodule F W =>
    (spaces.filter (fun E : Submodule F W => U ≤ E)).sup (fun E => Module.finrank F E)
  let L := 1 + Real.sqrt ((2 : ℝ)^d - 1)
  let typical := layer.filter (fun U : Submodule F W =>
    |2*(L+1)*((a-host U : ℕ) : ℝ)/(n : ℝ)-1| ≤ ε)
  (typical.card : ℝ)/(layer.card : ℝ)) Filter.atTop (nhds 1)

changed.title: Find a bounded nonlinear-depth selector exceeding the two-binomial-sum rank budget
changed.statement:
let nonlinear := fun (g : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) =>
  (g.inputs.length == 2) &&
  xor (xor (g.op.eval [false, false]) (g.op.eval [false, true]))
      (xor (g.op.eval [true, false]) (g.op.eval [true, true]))
let depth := fun (w : ℕ) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) =>
  (C.gates.foldl (fun (ds : List ℕ) g =>
    ds ++ [(g.inputs.map (fun a => ds.getD a 0)).foldr max 0 + (nonlinear g).toNat])
    (List.replicate w 0)).getD C.output 0
∃ (n m : ℕ) (G : Fin n → Fin m → Bool) (u : Fin n) (v : Fin m),
  let entry := fun (a : Fin n) (b : Fin m) => if G a b then (1 : ZMod 2) else 0
  let A : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin m) (ZMod 2) := fun i j =>
    entry i j + entry i v + entry u j + entry u v
  let represents := fun (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) =>
    (∀ g ∈ C.gates, g.inputs.length ≤ 2) ∧
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (n + m) C ∧
    PEqualNP.Represents.Represents G C
  let budget := fun (t b : ℕ) =>
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range b, Nat.choose (2*t) (j+1)) +
    (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (b-1), Nat.choose (2*t) (j+1))
  ∃ (d : ℕ) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit),
    represents C ∧ depth (n+m) C ≤ d+1 ∧
    budget (C.gates.countP nonlinear) (2^d) < A.rank

changed.title: Separated even-lane query kernels outperform consecutive pins exactly three through eight questions short of recovery
changed.statement:
∀ (t : ℕ) (ht : 0 < t) (j : ℕ), 1 ≤ j → j+3 ≤ t →
  let h := 3*t-2-j
  letI : ∀ p : Prop, Decidable p := Classical.propDecidable
  let F := ZMod 2
  let n := 6*t
  let W := Fin n → F
  let ix := fun j : ℕ => (⟨j % n, Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.mul_pos (Nat.zero_lt_succ 5) ht)⟩ : Fin n)
  let rot := fun (s : ℕ) (w : W) (i : Fin n) => w (ix (i.val + n - s % n))
  let out := fun (name c raw : W) (i : Fin n) =>
    let old := rot 3 raw + name
    let y := fun j : Fin n => old j + old (ix (j.val+2)) + old (ix (j.val+n-2))
    y i + (1+y (ix (i.val+1)))*y (ix (i.val+2)) + rot 4 raw i + c i
  let mix := fun (w : W) (i : Fin n) =>
    let old := rot 3 w
    old i + old (ix (i.val+2)) + old (ix (i.val+n-2))
  let a := 3*t
  let evenBit := fun (w : W) (i : Fin a) => mix w (ix (2*i.val))
  let next := fun (i : Fin a) => (⟨(i.val+1) % a, Nat.mod_lt _ (Nat.mul_pos (Nat.succ_pos 2) ht)⟩ : Fin a)
  ∀ name c : W,
    let win := fun (spaced : Bool) (k : ℕ) =>
      ∃ (v : Fin h → Fin a → F) (A : ℕ → W →ₗ[F] W) (b : ℕ → W),
        let q := fun (i : Fin h) (w : W) => ∑ s, v i s * evenBit w s
        let live := fun (s : Fin a) => ∃ w : W, (∀ i, q i w = 0) ∧ evenBit w s ≠ 0
        let run := fun w : W =>
          (List.finRange h).foldl (fun u i => 2*u + (if q i w = 0 then 0 else 1)) (0 : ℕ)
        (spaced = true → ∀ s, ¬ (live s ∧ live (next s))) ∧
        (spaced = false → ∀ i w, q i w = mix w (ix (2*i.val))) ∧
        k ≤ Nat.card {w : W // out name c w = A (run w) w + b (run w)}
    (∀ k, win true k ↔ 8^(j+1)*k ≤ (5^(j+1)+3^(j+1))*2^n) ∧
      ((∃ k, win true k ∧ ¬ win false k) ↔ 3 ≤ j ∧ j ≤ 8) ∧
      ((∃ k, win false k ∧ ¬ win true k) ↔ 9 ≤ j)
